  (cost_breakdown->'refund'->>'method') AS refund_type,
  SUM((cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value')::numeric) AS recovery_value,
  SUM(COALESCE((cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee')::numeric, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE((cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost')::numeric, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE((cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost')::numeric, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE((cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate')::numeric, 0)) AS total_return_cost,
  SUM((cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value')::numeric) - SUM(COALESCE((cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee')::numeric, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE((cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost')::numeric, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE((cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost')::numeric, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE((cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate')::numeric, 0)) AS net_impact
FROM financial_management
GROUP BY (cost_breakdown->'refund'->>'method')
ORDER BY refund_type;

WITH refund_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    cost_breakdown->'refund'->>'method' AS refund_type,
    SUM((cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value')::numeric) AS recovery_value,
    SUM(COALESCE((cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee')::numeric, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE((cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost')::numeric, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE((cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost')::numeric, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE((cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate')::numeric, 0)) AS total_return_cost
  FROM financial_management
  GROUP BY cost_breakdown->'refund'->>'method'
)
SELECT 
  refund_type,
  recovery_value,
  total_return_cost,
  CASE WHEN recovery_value > total_return_cost THEN 'Ahead' ELSE 'Behind' END AS ahead_behind
FROM refund_stats
ORDER BY refund_type;
